clue.text: Gas and gaiters with priest boring old style clerics

indicators.note: something boring drills into another thing, so it sits inside it

blocks.note: 'gas and gaiters' is pompous churchy talk and dress, the world of the bish, slang for a senior churchman
OS is the abbreviation for Old Style dating
P is the abbreviation for priest

explanation.surface: Pompous churchy talk and a dull priest, all in the manner of old-fashioned clergy.
explanation.walkthrough: Gaiters were part of a bishop's dress, so 'gas and gaiters' sums up episcopal pomp; the informal 'bish' is the man himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Bishops are senior members of the clergy, so the plural noun matches the plural clerics.

clue.text: Excellent promoter of literary studies holding up variety

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means reading the word from bottom to top
holding something keeps it within

blocks.note: the BA, British Academy, promotes the humanities
var. is the abbreviation for variety

explanation.surface: A literary society's excellent promoter holds up variety as a virtue.
explanation.walkthrough: A BA degree in literature also fits the phrase; either way the letters are the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Brava is the cry of 'well done!' to a female performer, an exclamation like 'excellent!'

clue.text: Fuss about slightly rejigged plan of crate's size?

indicators.note: rejigged a little means the order is only lightly changed
about means going round the rearranged word

blocks.note: a song, as in 'song and dance', is a fuss
taken as written

explanation.surface: Making a fuss over a slightly altered packing plan for a crate.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits a crate is only a sample of something that might be a span in length.
explanation.definitionFit: Spanlong means having the length of a span, the width of a spread hand, a small crate's measure.

clue.text: Familiarity is somewhat hot at first

indicators.note: at first places this piece at the front of the answer

blocks.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
a bit means somewhat

explanation.surface: Getting used to things is a little heated to start with.
explanation.definitionFit: Habit is the familiarity or settled practice acquired by repeating something.

clue.text: Wanly set about nappy, say

indicators.note: about means going round the other word

blocks.note: to ply is to set about or work at something
nappy is an old word for strong, heady ale, so nappy is an example of ale

explanation.surface: Someone wearily goes about changing a nappy.
explanation.walkthrough: A nappy is a British baby's diaper, which suits the weary parent; here it is old slang for strong beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Palely means in a pale way, with a wan colour.

clue.text: Street along with square giving rise to groups of plovers

blocks.note: ST is the abbreviation for street
and means along with
S is the abbreviation for square

explanation.surface: A town street and square produce a flock of plovers taking off.
explanation.walkthrough: Giving rise to suggests birds flying up; it only joins wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Stand is the collective noun for a flock of plovers, so the plural means groups of them.

clue.text: Ray Kennedy's header added to glut

indicators.note: a header is the top of something, so only the leading letter of the name is used
here the letter is added into the other word, not on its end

blocks.note: to sate is to glut; its first two letters wrap round the inserted letter
the first letter of Kennedy
the rest of the word meaning to glut

explanation.surface: A footballer named Ray Kennedy scores with a header in a glut of goals.
explanation.walkthrough: Ray Kennedy was a Liverpool and Arsenal footballer, so 'Ray' looks like a first name; it is the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A skate is a flat cartilaginous fish of the ray family.

clue.text: Dreadful scene surrounding Israel's secrecy

indicators.note: a dreadful version of something is botched, so its letters are messed up
surrounding means going all round the inserted letters

blocks.note: taken as written
IL is the international code for Israel

explanation.surface: A terrible incident wrapped in Israeli official secrecy.
explanation.definitionFit: Silence can mean reticence or refusal to speak, the keeping of secrets.

clue.text: Carp about what offers synonym for aborigine

indicators.note: about means wrapping round the other piece

blocks.note: a koi is an ornamental carp

clue.text: Divine assurance merits hope possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals one of several arrangements of the letters

blocks.note: taken as written

clue.text: Being abused Harley Street finally becomes mundane

the last letter of Street

explanation.walkthrough: Harley Street is London's street of private doctors, which sets the medical scene.

clue.text: Amends made by putting brassica back in to allotment

putting one thing in to another places it inside

explanation.walkthrough: 'Allotment' suggests a vegetable plot, which suits the brassica, but it means a share.

clue.text: Roar that's recurrent in desolate and dismal writer

blocks.note: to bell is to roar, as a rutting stag does
the one letter that occurs twice in desolate

explanation.walkthrough: 'Recurrent' points to the letter desolate repeats, not a repeated roar.

clue.text: Birthday dancer (about 50, right) — she's on the slippery slope?

explanation.walkthrough: The 'slippery slope' sounds like moral decline, but it is literally a ski slope.
explanation.definitionFit: A slalomer is a skier who races down a zigzag course of gates, so is on a slippery slope.

clue.text: Return of "Cleveland Indians", say — very toxic stuff

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so the word is read backwards

explanation.walkthrough: The Cleveland Indians renamed themselves the Guardians, hence the quotation marks; the team stands for any baseball side of nine.
explanation.definitionFit: Venin is a toxic substance found in snake venom.

clue.text: Discharge what could be true about power

blocks.note: taken as written
P is the symbol for power

explanation.definitionFit: To erupt is to burst out and discharge material, as a volcano does.

clue.text: Counting the whole caboodle singer carried line with Lord

clue.text: Car's trailer in roll

clue.text: Inductance in copper with a tendency to drop?

explanation.definitionFit: Blobby means full of blobs, globules that behave like liquid drops.

clue.text: Biden's throwaways lacking sign of original materials

clue.text: Second-rate leftovers topping clubhouse's soup

orts are scraps of leftover food

clue.text: Coach is relaxed about husband

blocks.note: the contracted form 's
cool can mean calm and relaxed
H is the abbreviation for husband

clue.text: Generous drink as a nightcap
